verdict.rationale: Metorial has a public REST API reference: llms.txt indexes an API reference section, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec is served at /openapi.json, and the live API returns structured, key-gated errors. The docs also include copyable SDK code snippets and API key setup steps. Nothing shows the reference is interactive or that its examples can be run in-browser, so only the reference-plus-spec part of the story is evidenced. missing for 10: evidence of an interactive API explorer or try-it console, runnable in-page examples, and independent hands-on corroboration of the reference experience.
